name: Dogma Paint Stroke Dissolve
description: Kim Ximya 'Dogma' (Park Chan-kyong, 2026-09-04 surprise 26-min single): crossfades end-to-end with paint-stroke masks and layered spatial zooms. Reads as moving painting, audio-reactive dissolves NOT cuts. Resolve 20 / Fusion paint-stroke mask node analog — heavy blur, liquid warp, painterly grain.
